profile.headline: Software Engineer at Xometry
profile.summary:
I am an efficient and organized software developer. I thrive in a fast-paced environment and have strong problem-solving skills. Having worked with many different types of clients and various frameworks and languages; I consider myself to be a quick-learner, a natural multitasker, and an effective communicator. My focus is utilizing the best tool for the job to create robust and simple solutions.

Please feel free to contact me at hknguyen13@gmail.com

positions.title: Co-Foudner & CTO
positions.description:
Launched a startup program, in Louisville, Kentucky, geared towards improving the training programs for restaurants and bars.

Cloud-based software learning management system, with multiple levels of access to monitor the 
progress of staff. 

Recognized by the University of Louisville College of Business.

positions.title: Co-founder/Web Developer
positions.description:
Assisted in deciding company goals and paths.
Implemented the use of Ruby on Rails to create desired web applications.
Designed websites with the use of CSS, JS, and raw HTML code.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Updated websites and applications as designated by the client.
Learned about various CMS tools such as Joomla, Drupal, and WordPress.
Worked with a variety of web application frameworks and tools.

positions.title: Team Alpha Intern
positions.description:
Met team goals while working in groups, contributing ideas and skills towards a target project. 
Worked with developing websites from conception to production on multiple occasions. 
Handled a majority of CSS, HTML, and back-end work for company sites. 
Participated in a variety of team-bonding exercises and outings to create a joyful work environment.

positions.title: Sales/Tech Position
positions.description: Formatted and repaired Windows/Apple laptops and successfully communicated with customers

positions.title: Caterer
positions.description: Learned effective communication skills as well as utilized good judgment and improvisational techniques while working in a fast-paced environment

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Utilized Gaussian 09 software to determine most stable orientation of molecules within a theoretical chemical compound 

Setup command scripts according to Gaussian 09 syntax and its programming structure

Filed commands through a queue to multiple Transylvania supercomputers from a remote location, ensuring efficient use of supercomputer load

Traveled to the American Chemical Society (ACS) conferences to present the results of this research in a poster presentation; “Solvent Effects on Hydrogen Bonding”

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description: Scheduled meetings with potential customers and worked in a group to meet company goals

positions.title: Office Assitant
positions.description:
Gained an understanding of the procedures used for patient diagnosis and observed the daily routines of a Pediatrician

Organized patient records and filed insurance claims; learned the importance and responsibility of patient confidentiality through interactions with patient charts and sitting in on patient-doctor interactions
